commit_message: Model runtime: avoid runpy double-import warning

actions.content:
"""Hermclaw model routing and Ollama residency management.

Submodules are intentionally not imported eagerly here. This keeps
python -m model_runtime.model_manager and python -m model_runtime.router
free of runpy double-import warnings.
"""

__all__ = [
    "ModelManager",
    "ModelProfile",
    "RoutingDecision",
    "load_profiles",
    "route_task",
]


def __getattr__(name):
    if name in {"ModelManager", "ModelProfile", "load_profiles"}:
        from .model_manager import ModelManager, ModelProfile, load_profiles
        return {
            "ModelManager": ModelManager,
            "ModelProfile": ModelProfile,
            "load_profiles": load_profiles,
        }[name]
    if name in {"RoutingDecision", "route_task"}:
        from .router import RoutingDecision, route_task
        return {
            "RoutingDecision": RoutingDecision,
            "route_task": route_task,
        }[name]
    raise AttributeError(name)
